attrs.aria: Copy prompt: Install the Rive CLI from rive.app/cli and use it to build a drivable night city. Put me in the driver’s seat of a hovercar whose dashboard screens and windshield HUD are live Rive artboards with state machines, animations and data binding. Fill the skyline with animated, clickable billboards that are also Rive artboards. Render it in 3D with GPU Canvas.

Copy prompt: Looks great, now let’s make it cinematic. Add a title screen where the city builds itself before the Rive logo appears, with lighting closer to golden hour. Make the HUD smaller and glassier, keep billboards on building faces, and let me stop in front of one and play with it.
Copy prompt: Push this to my Rive account so I can open it in the Editor.
